 Momcozy Celebrates 11.11 with a Focus on Making Every Mom Moment Better
 By VOICE OF ASIA - October 29, 2026 0 134 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 The regional 11.11 Cozy Sale runs from 1–14 November 2026, with savings of up to 25% on participating products and a special limited-stock offer of 30% off the Wellness 1 across Southeast Asia.
 KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia, 29 October 2026 — This 11.11, Momcozy invites moms across Southeast Asia to upgrade every mom moment with practical solutions for everyday motherhood. From 1-14 November 2026, shoppers can enjoy up to 25% off participating products on Momcozy’s official stores on Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Lazada.
 A highlight of this year’s Cozy Sale is a special 30% discount on the Wellness 1 Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump, available in limited quantities across Southeast Asia while stocks last. Bringing warmth, massage and pumping together in one wearable device, the offer gives moms an opportunity to upgrade their pumping routine at a special 11.11 price.
 Motherhood is made up of countless everyday moments, and even small improvements can make a meaningful difference. With ‘Upgrade Every Mom Moment,’ we want to empower moms to discover practical solutions that fit their real lives—making feeding, caregiving, and everyday routines feel a little more comfortable and manageable.
 Find Your Mom Moment Upgrade This 11.11
 Upgrade Your Pumping Moment 
 The campaign reflects Momcozy’s Putting Moms First philosophy by connecting product features with the experiences they are designed to support.
 The Wellness 1 Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump combines 360° wraparound warmth, synchronised vibration massage and baby-inspired SoftPulse suction. Three warmth settings and app controls allow users to personalise their sessions, bringing warmth, massage and pumping together in a wearable device. W1 will be available at 30% off in limited quantities across Southeast Asia this 11.11, while stocks last.
 The Air 1 Ultra-slim Breast Pump offers a slim wearable profile, a transparent top for checking alignment and monitoring milk collection, and a wireless charging case for charging and storage between sessions. These features address practical considerations for mothers incorporating pumping into work and other daily commitments.
 The two models demonstrate different approaches to supporting mothers’ preferences, with the Wellness 1 emphasising integrated warmth and massage and the Air 1 focusing on a slim design and portability.
 Upgrade Your After-Feeding Moment 
 The KleanPal Pro Baby Bottle Washer and Sterilizer(BS03) combines washing, steam sterilising, drying and storage functions. It accommodates up to four bottles with accessories, depending on the load, and offers a 19-minute rapid wash, with additional time required for sterilising and drying. By automating several stages of bottle care, it can reduce the hands-on work required of parents and caregivers.
 Upgrade Your On-the-Go Moment
 For families feeding away from home, Momcozy’s portable breast milk warmer serves complementary purposes. The cooler is designed to keep expressed milk chilled during transport, while the rechargeable, cordless warmer provides an option for warming a portion when needed. Together, they support parents planning feeds around work, family visits and travel.
 Find Your Mom Moment Upgrade This 11.11 
 The Momcozy 11.11 Cozy Sale will be available through participating official stores on Shopee, TikTok Shop and Lazada. Product availability, offers, and promotion dates may vary by market and channel. Consumers can refer to their local official stores for confirmed prices and terms. 
 With “Upgrade Every Mom Moment,” Momcozy celebrates the little moments that make up motherhood and the meaningful difference small comforts can bring. By creating solutions that fit into moms’ everyday lives, Momcozy hopes to make each moment of feeding, caring, and growing together a little easier, more comfortable, and more cozy—because every mom deserves moments that feel better, too.
 Discover more ways to upgrade every mom moment this 11.11 in The Asian Parent’s Shopping Guide .
